meta.name: genomic-intelligence
meta.description: Predict regulatory features, gene structure, and expression directly from DNA sequence using Genomic Intelligence's hosted transformer DNA language models — no local GPU or model weights. Six tasks over a REST API and a hosted MCP server (keyless public demo): promoter regions, splice donor/acceptor sites, enhancer activity, chromatin state, sequence-to-expression (log TPM), and de-novo gene annotation, plus a composite find-genes-then-predict-expression workflow. Use when the user has a gene symbol, a genomic region, or a DNA/FASTA sequence and wants any of these predictions, mentions Genomic Intelligence, genomicintelligence.ai, api.genomicintelligence.ai, or mcp.genomicintelligence.ai.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入基因名或一段 DNA 序列,直接预测启动子、剪接位点、增强子活性和表达量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有基因符号或 DNA 序列,想快速拿到调控与表达层面的预测结果
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a gene symbol or DNA sequence and want quick regulatory and expression predictions

howto.what: 把基因符号、基因组区域或 DNA/FASTA 序列发给 Genomic Intelligence 的云端 DNA 模型,取回启动子、剪接位点、增强子活性、染色质状态、表达量(log TPM)、基因注释等结构化预测;本地不跑模型权重,无需 GPU。
howto.when: 当你给出基因符号、基因组区域或 DNA/FASTA 序列并想要上述任一预测,或提到 “Genomic Intelligence”、“genomicintelligence.ai” 等名称时触发。

say.note: 调用 promoter 任务,返回启动子区段

say.text: 预测这段序列的剪接供体和受体位点
say.note: 调用 splice 任务,按转录方向提交

say.text: 以 K562 细胞预测这段序列的表达量(log TPM)
say.note: expression 任务需给细胞类型描述

howto.what_en: Sends a gene symbol, region, or DNA/FASTA sequence to Genomic Intelligence's hosted DNA models, returning promoter, splice, enhancer, chromatin, expression (log TPM), and gene annotation predictions. Nothing runs locally.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you have a gene symbol, genomic region, or DNA/FASTA sequence and want any of these predictions, or mention Genomic Intelligence, genomicintelligence.ai, or its MCP/API hosts.

say_en.text: Find the promoter regions in this sequence
say_en.note: Runs the promoter task and returns regions

say_en.text: Predict splice donor and acceptor sites in this sequence
say_en.note: Runs the splice task; feed transcript orientation

say_en.text: Predict expression for this sequence in K562 cells as log TPM
say_en.note: expression task needs a cell-type description
